name: Takizawa Risa
source:
A mature, dignified woman who is usually cool, but sometimes gets sweet and friendly.

Speaks her own opinion; independent and mature lady.
Since she has an older-sister like quality, All men and women admire and depend on her.
Although she is independent and mature, she is inexperienced with relationships, so she is not very knowledgeable about romances.
It is not easy to get intimate with her, but she might show you her deep affection once you do…

[From [url=http://com3d2.world/r18/chara.html#rindere] English Official Site[/url]]

One of the three original or early employed Maids. A mature and dignified young lady who is quite like an older sister to the other girls.

NOTE: Measurements bases from in-game original presets, Everything, including name and except her personality is up to the Master to decide.

A Rindere is similar yet different to the common Coodere in that one still very much shows emotions, mostly with a mature, calm and strict attitude while in contrary to a Tsundere those emotions are not a facade. Of course the -dere part still very much means that they care.
